acceptance: A sealed FAIL of a lane item raises its failure_count by one and records the failure class (red test first)
An infra or quota failure does not raise failure_count
At the quarantine ceiling a non-system failure moves the item to quarantine
fix: Restore one failure record per sealed FAIL of a lane item: bump failure_count and keep the last failure class and fingerprint from the retry-ladder classifier (go/internal/retryladder) on the item, through the lifecycle verbs only. TDD first with a fixture FAIL; 100% coverage on changed functions; zero comments; update docs/architecture/retry-ladder.md §5 and the inboxmover package note.
summary: Every item that failed in waves 130 to 133 shows failure_count 0, for example history-refusal-names-the-evolve-comments-command-lane after three failed cycles (1958, 1966, 1975). Cycle 1864 (commit 6e477f7b8, 2026-10-13, item inboxmover-dead-quarantine-writer) removed the only production call of bumpFailureCount; go/internal/inboxmover/inboxmover.go:190 now has no caller. So the ADR-0076 deep floor (core/retry_tier_escalation.go:31, failure_count >= 1) and the quarantine ceiling (lifecycle.ShouldQuarantine) can never fire. ADR-0142 D10 also needs the class of the last failure of an item to pick its start rung.
title: An inbox item's failure_count is never bumped, so the deep floor and the quarantine ceiling never fire
